# Plug v1.20.2 - Table of Contents

> Compose web applications with functions

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Plug](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Guides
  - [HTTPS](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/https.md)

## Modules

- [Plug](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.md): The plug specification.
- [Plug.Builder](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Builder.md): Conveniences for building plugs.
- [Plug.Conn](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.md): The Plug connection.
- [Plug.HTML](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.HTML.md): Conveniences for generating HTML.

- [Plug.Router](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Router.md): A DSL to define a routing algorithm that works with Plug.
- [Plug.Test](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Test.md): Conveniences for testing plugs.
- [Plug.Upload](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Upload.md): A server (a `GenServer` specifically) that manages uploaded files.

- Plugs
  - [Plug.BasicAuth](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.BasicAuth.md): Functionality for providing Basic HTTP authentication.
  - [Plug.CSRFProtection](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.CSRFProtection.md): Plug to protect from cross-site request forgery.
  - [Plug.Head](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Head.md): A Plug to convert `HEAD` requests to `GET` requests.
  - [Plug.Logger](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Logger.md): A plug for logging basic request information in the format
  - [Plug.MethodOverride](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.MethodOverride.md): This plug overrides the request's `POST` method with the method defined in
the `_method` request parameter.
  - [Plug.Parsers](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.md): A plug for parsing the request body.
  - [Plug.RequestId](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.RequestId.md): A plug for generating a unique request ID for each request.
  - [Plug.RewriteOn](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.RewriteOn.md): A plug to rewrite the request's host/port/protocol from `x-forwarded-*` headers.
  - [Plug.SSL](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.SSL.md): A plug to force SSL connections and enable HSTS.
  - [Plug.Session](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Session.md): A plug to handle session cookies and session stores.
  - [Plug.Static](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Static.md): A plug for serving static assets.
  - [Plug.Telemetry](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Telemetry.md): A plug to instrument the pipeline with `:telemetry` events.

- Error handling
  - [Plug.Debugger](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Debugger.md): A module (**not a plug**) for debugging in development.
  - [Plug.ErrorHandler](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.ErrorHandler.md): A module to be used in your existing plugs in order to provide
error handling.
  - [Plug.Exception](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Exception.md): A protocol that extends exceptions to be status-code aware.

- Plug.Conn
  - [Plug.Conn.Adapter](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.Adapter.md): Specification of the connection adapter API implemented by webservers.
  - [Plug.Conn.Cookies](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.Cookies.md): Conveniences for encoding and decoding cookies.

  - [Plug.Conn.Query](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.Query.md): Conveniences for decoding and encoding URL-encoded queries.
  - [Plug.Conn.Status](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.Status.md): Conveniences for working with status codes.

  - [Plug.Conn.Unfetched](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.Unfetched.md): A struct used as default on unfetched fields.
  - [Plug.Conn.Utils](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.Utils.md): Utilities for working with connection data

- Plug.Parsers
  - [Plug.Parsers.JSON](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.JSON.md): Parses JSON request body.
  - [Plug.Parsers.MULTIPART](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.MULTIPART.md): Parses multipart request body.
  - [Plug.Parsers.URLENCODED](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.URLENCODED.md): Parses urlencoded request body.

- Plug.Session
  - [Plug.Session.COOKIE](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Session.COOKIE.md): Stores the session in a cookie.
  - [Plug.Session.ETS](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Session.ETS.md): Stores the session in an in-memory ETS table.
  - [Plug.Session.Store](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Session.Store.md): Specification for session stores.

- Exceptions
  - [Plug.BadRequestError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.BadRequestError.md): The request will not be processed due to a client error.

  - [Plug.CSRFProtection.InvalidCSRFTokenError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.CSRFProtection.InvalidCSRFTokenError.md): Error raised when CSRF token is invalid.
  - [Plug.CSRFProtection.InvalidCrossOriginRequestError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.CSRFProtection.InvalidCrossOriginRequestError.md): Error raised when non-XHR requests are used for Javascript responses.
  - [Plug.Conn.AlreadySentError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.AlreadySentError.md): Error raised when trying to modify or send an already sent response

  - [Plug.Conn.CookieOverflowError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.CookieOverflowError.md): Error raised when the cookie exceeds the maximum size of 4096 bytes.

  - [Plug.Conn.InvalidHeaderError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.InvalidHeaderError.md): Error raised when trying to send a header that has errors, for example
  - [Plug.Conn.InvalidQueryError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.InvalidQueryError.md): Raised when the request string is malformed, for example
  - [Plug.Conn.NotSentError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.NotSentError.md): Error raised when no response is sent in a request

  - [Plug.Conn.WrapperError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Conn.WrapperError.md): Wraps the connection in an error which is meant
to be handled upper in the stack.
  - [Plug.Parsers.BadEncodingError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.BadEncodingError.md): Raised when the request body contains bad encoding.

  - [Plug.Parsers.ParseError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.ParseError.md): Error raised when the request body is malformed.

  - [Plug.Parsers.RequestTooLargeError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.RequestTooLargeError.md): Error raised when the request is too large.

  - [Plug.Parsers.UnsupportedMediaTypeError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Parsers.UnsupportedMediaTypeError.md): Error raised when the request body cannot be parsed.

  - [Plug.Router.InvalidSpecError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Router.InvalidSpecError.md)
  - [Plug.Router.MalformedURIError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Router.MalformedURIError.md)
  - [Plug.Static.InvalidPathError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Static.InvalidPathError.md)
  - [Plug.TimeoutError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.TimeoutError.md): Timeout while waiting for the request.

  - [Plug.UploadError](https://plug.hexdocs.pm/Plug.UploadError.md)
